facts.statement: Primary key column id must be uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), declared once (do not combine an inline PRIMARY KEY with a second table-level PRIMARY KEY constraint).
Multi-tenant tables must include tenant_id uuid NOT NULL.
Every foreign key constraint must use ON DELETE RESTRICT.
Monetary and decimal columns must use numeric (never float, real, double precision, or money).
Every table must include created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now().
Mutable tables must include updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); append-only tables must omit updated_at.
All timestamp columns must use timestamptz, never timestamp without time zone.
Text columns must use text rather than varchar(n) or char(n).
JSON columns must use jsonb NOT NULL, never json.
Mutable tables must include nullable deleted_at timestamptz; append-only tables must omit deleted_at.
IP address columns must use inet, never text or varchar.
Status or state columns must be text NOT NULL validated by a CHECK (col IN (...)) constraint.
Table name must be snake_case plural in public schema and belong to the allow-list of task nouns.
Primary key constraint named pk_<table>.
Foreign key columns must be named [<role>_]<singular_ref_table>_id (e.g., user_id or actor_user_id) or supersedes_id for self-FK on append-only tables.
Foreign key constraints must be named fk_<table>_<column>.
Check constraints must be named chk_<table>_<column>.
Explicit non-constraint indexes must be named idx_<table>_<col1>[_<col2>...] by joining all indexed column names in order with underscores (skipping constraint-backed indexes).

Append-only tables must revoke UPDATE, DELETE, and TRUNCATE from PUBLIC, application, and readonly_user, and explicitly GRANT SELECT ON TABLE public.<table> TO readonly_user and GRANT SELECT, INSERT ON TABLE public.<table> TO application.
Append-only tables must have a BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE trigger that raises 'Update/Delete operation rejected on audit log'.
Mutable tables must have a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that advances updated_at.
Every foreign key column must be covered as the leading column of an index.
Multi-tenant tables must index tenant_id as the leading column of an index.
Unique business keys on soft-deletable mutable tables must use a partial unique index with WHERE deleted_at IS NULL.
Multi-tenant tables must have ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY and FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY.
Tenant RLS policies must scope rows by app_metadata.tenant_id for application and grant zero access to user_metadata.tenant_id.
Append-only tables must define zero FOR UPDATE, FOR DELETE, or FOR ALL RLS policies.
Merged into F-26 during reconciliation.
Removed during reconciliation.
Write RLS policies must never use tautological USING (true) or WITH CHECK (true).
SECURITY DEFINER functions must explicitly set SET search_path = ''.
Ingestion tables must enforce a UNIQUE constraint on idempotency_key (scoped by tenant_id when tenant = true).
Removed during reconciliation.
Counter and quota columns must enforce a non-negative CHECK (<col> >= 0) constraint against underflow.
Replaced by F-34 during reconciliation.

Append-only tables must include a nullable self-referential foreign key column supersedes_id uuid NULL with an explicit table-level constraint named fk_<table>_supersedes_id FOREIGN KEY (supersedes_id) REFERENCES public.<table>(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT (never an inline REFERENCES clause).
Ingestion tables must attach a BEFORE INSERT trigger forcing NEW.received_at = now() regardless of client input.
Observation tables must define a composite B-tree index on (<key>, observed_at DESC).
Exposed views must be created with WITH (security_invoker = true).
